primary_endpoint: Percent change in hepatic fat fraction by MRI-PDFF from baseline at 12 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 12 weeks, percent changes were −11.31% (25 mg US), −27.59% (50 mg US), −28.68% (50 mg China), and −35.77% (75 mg US); placebo changes were 2.52% (US) and −15.63% (China). No statistical comparisons were reported.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths were reported in any arm.
